question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: Trailing-four-quarter operating cash flow over net income is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, inside the company's own annual range: {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2024, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2023, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2022; the fiscal 2025 reading of {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} is inflated because that year's net income carried the federal valuation-allowance charge. Trailing accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}, negative as in every filled year except fiscal 2022 ({trend_table.years-back-3.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets}); the fiscal 2025 annual cell is {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets}, the lowest of five years, for the same tax reason. The trailing window is therefore adequate, but the quarter is not: operating cash flow for the three months is {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter} against net income of {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter}, down {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct} year over year and {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.quarter_over_quarter|pct} against the prior quarter, the lowest of the nine quarters the smoothness series reads, while net income fell only {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year|pct} and operating income fell {ratios.growth.operating_income.year_over_year|pct}. The gap between operating income and net income is investment and other income that the MD&A attributes to IPO gains on QSI investees; the fair-value footnote says those shares remain under lock-up and the income footnote says the gains are primarily unrealized, so part of the quarter's reported earnings is a mark that has not become cash. Working capital: inventory rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change} year over year, absorbing {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.share_of_net_income|pct} of trailing net income, which the MD&A ties to customer demand impacts from memory supply constraints; payables rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change}, {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.share_of_net_income|pct} of net income, supplying cash; the cash-flow statement's trailing increase in receivables is {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.cash_flow_statement_change}, but the receivables balance-sheet change, articulation gap and share of net income are missing because the quarterly filings tag the receivable line under a concept the calculator does not read. Articulation: inventory's balance-sheet change exceeds the cash-flow statement's by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap} and payables' by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap}; both gaps are small against the moves and are consistent with balances brought in by the year's acquisitions, which bypass the operating lines. Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}, well above one: net income moves more than operating cash flow, not less, because of the fiscal 2025 valuation-allowance charge and its release in the second quarter of fiscal 2026 — no sign of earnings smoothing, but a sign that reported net income is driven by tax and investment items rather than operations.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: weakening — trailing conversion within history, but the latest quarter converts poorly, inventory absorbs a large share of net income, and the quarter's earnings lean on unrealized investment gains while the year's lean on a tax release

revenue_recognition.dropped: finding: a number written in the analyst's own words: 'ing cannot be read for any quarter: the 10-Qs tag the receivable line as Account'

estimates_and_reserves.finding: Reserves cannot be tested: the record tags no allowance for credit losses, no inventory valuation reserve and no warranty accrual in any period, so the bad-debt, inventory-reserve and warranty-reserve ratios are unfilled in every quarter and year, and the inventory components are stated net of reserves; thinning is unobservable, which matters because inventory days are at a six-quarter high and the MD&A warns that trade-policy uncertainty may bring excess or obsolete inventory charges. Tax is the dominant estimate: a U.S. federal deferred-tax valuation allowance was built in fiscal 2025 and released in the second quarter of fiscal 2026 — a realisability judgment reversed within the following fiscal year — and the tax note says that release drives an estimated annual effective rate that is a benefit for fiscal 2026; net deferred tax assets stepped up and the year-to-date tax line is a benefit. Over the trailing four quarters income tax expense is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense} on pretax income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.pretax_income}, an effective rate of {tax_rate|pct}, because the trailing window holds both the build and the release and they offset; no calculator field carries the release itself, so no adjustment is written for it and the point is recorded here. The quarter's effective rate rose against the year-ago quarter, which the note attributes to discrete benefits a year ago; the FDDEI benefit will be smaller in fiscal 2026 because domestic research is now deducted currently. Unrecognized tax benefits rose and the company says they could reasonably change within twelve months without giving a direction. Goodwill rose with Alphawave and seven other acquisitions; goodwill headroom, discount-rate and growth assumptions are not in a 10-Q and not in the calculator. The Alphawave allocation table is marked changed and the Alphawave goodwill fact was revised downward against the April 10-Q with every other allocation line unchanged and no text explaining the measurement-period adjustment. Estimate-driven income: the nine-month QSI bridge includes gains from observable price changes on non-marketable equity investments and higher equity-method earnings — remeasurements of holdings without market prices; the Modular consideration includes executive shares whose split between compensation expense and purchase price is a judgment still to be made. Accrued customer incentives rose with payment timing cited; those accruals are variable-consideration estimates, and the increase supplied operating cash this period. Restructuring charges, substantially all severance, were recorded in each quarter of the year.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: estimate-heavy — a valuation-allowance release reversed within a year of its build, reserves unobservable, remeasurement gains on unquoted holdings, and a quietly revised goodwill allocation

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: Factoring and supply-chain finance: the record tags no proceeds from sale of receivables and no supplier finance obligation in any period, no guarantee maximum exposure, and no unconditional purchase obligation at the June balance date; nothing found, with the caveat that absence from the tagged record is not a statement that none exists — the notes refer to advance payments under multi-year capacity purchase commitments being utilised. Classification: the cash-flow statement's acquisition spend sits under no tag the calculator reads, so the acquisitions family has no line on record and quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted} (from simple free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple} less share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}) subtracts no acquisition cash, even though the MD&A lists cash used for acquisitions and other investments among the year's uses and investing outflows rose; the quality-adjusted figure is overstated by an amount not in the calculator. Repayment of debt assumed from an acquired company, {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_repaid}, is in financing although it is acquisition consideration in substance; an adjustment is written for it. Acquisitions paid in shares — Alphawave in the first quarter and Modular after quarter-end — never touch the cash-flow statement, and the MD&A says repurchases include buybacks that offset the Alphawave share issuance: the cash cost of stock-funded deals is thereby routed through financing as repurchases, where it reads as a return of capital rather than an investment. Trailing repurchases of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases} exceed quality-adjusted free cash flow; cash fell to {terms.balances_now.cash} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.cash} and current marketable securities to {terms.balances_now.short_term_investments} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.short_term_investments}, total debt rose to {terms.debt_now} from {terms.debt_a_year_earlier} with current debt of {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current} appearing where there was none, and net commercial paper proceeds and the release of restricted cash bridged the gap; net debt is {ratios.solvency.net_debt}. Capital expenditure rose to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure} from {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.capital_expenditure}. Share-based compensation is treated as the real cost it is in the quality-adjusted figure. Leases: the operating lease liability is stated only at the fiscal 2025 year-end, {ratios.solvency.operating_lease_liability}, not at June. No variable-interest entity disclosure is in the input. Interest-rate swap notional rose, converting fixed to floating on part of the debt.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: no factoring or supplier finance in the record; the real issue is acquisition cash that the calculator does not capture and stock-funded deals offset by buybacks, so free cash flow after real costs is lower than the adjusted figure shows and returns are being funded from cash and paper

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: Every notes item was tested against the numbers reader and the calculator; the outcomes are in the reconciliation list. Most items are confirmed: the revenue and net income declines, the IPO-gain lift to investment income, the gross-margin decline, the research and development, selling, general and administrative and restructuring increases, the automotive growth, the short-term debt appearance, the cash decline and its uses, the inventory build, the swap notional, the tax-rate forecast, the Modular and other acquisitions, the Alphawave table change, and the guidance ranges. Two are contradicted: the release lists a restructuring amount for the quarter that is higher than the amount tagged in the 10-Q and stated in the note, and the income-statement line the 10-Q tags as realized gains on marketable securities is described in the footnote as primarily unrealized gains on equity securities under lock-up — the amount agrees, the character does not. The rest are unresolved because the numbers report carries no fact for them: Data Center revenue, QTL estimated sales, unrecognized tax benefits, the advance supply payments, the customer-incentive accrual, the European Commission fine, the IoT reclassification, the OEM licence expirations, the litigation events, future cash taxes and pricing actions, the long-range targets, and the claim that revenue was at the high end of guidance, for which the prior guidance range is not in the input. Does the 8-K match the 10-Q: on revenue, net income, diluted earnings per share, the inventory and receivables cash-flow lines, the restricted-cash opening balance, the dividend per share and the guidance footnotes, yes; the exceptions are the restructuring amount, the European Commission fine interest that the release excludes from non-GAAP but the contingencies note in the input does not mention, and the pricing actions the release describes that the MD&A's parallel paragraph omits. The release's headlines feature non-handset growth while its own table and the MD&A show handset revenue falling and total QCT revenue down; the numbers support both sides.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: largely consistent — two small contradictions (restructuring amount, realized-versus-unrealized labelling) and a release that is more promotional than the MD&A on pricing and on non-handset growth

industry_lens.finding: Inventory obsolescence: days sales of inventory are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, the highest of six quarters, from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} the prior quarter, {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} a year earlier and {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} for fiscal 2025 (the five-year annual high was {trend_table.years-back-2.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} in fiscal 2023); the trailing average-inventory measure is {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory}; inventory is {terms.balances_now.inventory} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory} a year earlier, every component is up and raw materials and work in process grew most, with gross margin at its six-quarter low ({trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}) and the reserve unobservable. Management's cause is customer demand impacts from memory supply constraints; that explains a build but not why raw materials and work in process lead it, which reads more like committed purchases and production continuing into softer demand, consistent with the advance supply payments being consumed. Purchase commitments in excess of need: the notes refer to multi-year capacity purchase commitments and the MD&A to rising supplier costs and capacity constraints, but no commitment amount is in the record for the June date, so the test cannot be completed; the combination of rising inventory, falling revenue and prepaid capacity is the pattern that precedes excess-commitment charges. Customer concentration: the largest customer is {concentration.facts.39.value|pct} of the quarter's revenue against {concentration.facts.21.value|pct} a year earlier, and {concentration.facts.40.value|pct} year to date against {concentration.facts.22.value|pct}; the second is {concentration.facts.41.value|pct} against {concentration.facts.23.value|pct}; a third customer that was {concentration.facts.25.value|pct} in the year-ago quarter has no fact for the current quarter; China was {concentration.facts.27.value|pct} of fiscal 2025 revenue; concentration in the top customer is rising while handset revenue falls. Channel stuffing: the one signal is receivables rising ({terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_receivables} trailing) while revenue falls ({ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct}), alongside rising accrued customer incentives with payment timing cited and a drawdown of unearned revenue; no disclosure of extended terms, returns or sell-through is in the input, so the signal is unresolved rather than confirmed. Circular or vendor-financed deals: nothing found — no item links a QSI investee to a customer or a financed sale; the observation is that the QSI segment supplied a large part of the quarter's pretax income through IPO and remeasurement gains that the release itself excludes from non-GAAP as unrelated to operations.
industry_lens.verdict: elevated — inventory at a six-quarter high with unobservable reserves and unquantified capacity commitments, rising top-customer concentration, one unexplained channel signal, no circular-deal evidence

anomalies.name: Soft asset share at a six-quarter high
anomalies.name_ko: 소프트 자산 비중 여섯 분기 최고
anomalies.what: Soft asset share is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct}, from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} the prior quarter and {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} a year earlier, against {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} for fiscal 2025; the drivers are goodwill, deferred tax assets and inventory up and cash down.

anomalies.name: Non-GAAP gap unmeasurable; non-GAAP tax method changed
anomalies.name_ko: 비GAAP 격차 측정 불가, 비GAAP 세율 방식 변경
anomalies.what: No us-gaap concept carries non-GAAP net income, so the gap is unfilled in every period; the release prints non-GAAP net income above GAAP for the quarter and guides non-GAAP earnings per share well above GAAP with share-based compensation the largest reconciling item, and a fixed non-GAAP tax rate has applied since the first quarter of fiscal 2026 without prior periods being recast.

anomalies.name: Research and development stated net of customer reimbursements
anomalies.name_ko: 연구개발비가 고객 상환금 차감 후 순액으로 표시
anomalies.what: The quarter's research and development increase is attributed mainly to lower non-recurring engineering reimbursements, so reported expense of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense} over the trailing four quarters is net of amounts customers pay, and prior periods were lower partly for that reason; the gross figure is not disclosed.

anomalies.name: Share-based compensation rising
anomalies.name_ko: 주식보상비용 증가
anomalies.what: Trailing share-based compensation is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} against {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.share_based_compensation} in fiscal 2025 and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.share_based_compensation} in fiscal 2024, is named as a driver of both expense lines, and Modular's executive shares will add to it.

anomalies.name: Acquisition cash not captured in quality-adjusted free cash flow
anomalies.name_ko: 인수 현금이 품질조정 잉여현금흐름에 반영되지 않음
anomalies.what: The cash-flow statement's acquisition spend sits under no tag the calculator reads, so quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted} subtracts no acquisition cash although the MD&A lists cash used for acquisitions and other investments and investing outflows rose; the numbers reader's investing figure agrees with the MD&A, so the gap is the calculator's, and the adjusted figure is overstated by an amount not in the calculator.

anomalies.name: Share-funded acquisitions offset by repurchases
anomalies.name_ko: 주식 지급 인수를 자사주 매입으로 상쇄
anomalies.what: Alphawave and Modular were paid largely in shares, which never pass through the cash-flow statement, and the MD&A says repurchases include buybacks that offset the Alphawave issuance; trailing repurchases of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases} therefore carry acquisition cost in the guise of a return of capital, and exceed quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}.

anomalies.name: Acquired company's debt repaid through financing
anomalies.name_ko: 피인수회사 부채 상환이 재무활동으로 분류
anomalies.what: Repayment of debt of an acquired company, {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_repaid}, is the only borrowing repayment of the year and sits in financing although it is acquisition consideration in substance; an adjustment reduces cash flow by it.

anomalies.name: Returns exceed free cash flow, funded from cash and commercial paper
anomalies.name_ko: 주주환원이 잉여현금흐름을 초과, 현금과 기업어음으로 조달
anomalies.what: Trailing repurchases of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases} against simple free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}; cash fell to {terms.balances_now.cash} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.cash}, total debt rose to {terms.debt_now} from {terms.debt_a_year_earlier} with current debt of {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current} where there was none, net debt is {ratios.solvency.net_debt}, and net commercial paper and released restricted cash bridged the gap. A difference from the company's own past rather than a disagreement with the text.

anomalies.name: Capacity purchase commitments not quantified in the record
anomalies.name_ko: 생산능력 구매약정 금액이 기록에 없음
anomalies.what: The notes refer to advance payments under multi-year capacity purchase commitments being utilised and the MD&A to supplier cost and capacity pressure, but no unconditional purchase obligation is tagged at the June date, so the off-balance-sheet commitment cannot be sized against the rising inventory.

anomalies.name: Capital expenditure stepped up
anomalies.name_ko: 설비투자 증가
anomalies.what: Trailing capital expenditure is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.capital_expenditure} a year earlier, with net property, plant and equipment higher; a change from the company's own past, not a classification issue.

anomalies.name: Commercial paper tagging context changed
anomalies.name_ko: 기업어음 태깅 컨텍스트 변경
anomalies.what: The current 10-Q tags commercial paper without the credit-facility dimension the April 10-Q used; values agree where both exist, and the new short-term debt schedule splits the balance into commercial paper and current long-term debt.

anomalies.name: Non-GAAP tax method changed without recasting prior periods
anomalies.name_ko: 비GAAP 세율 방식 변경, 과거 기간 미수정
anomalies.what: From the first quarter of fiscal 2026 a fixed estimated non-GAAP tax rate applies and prior periods were not updated on materiality grounds, so non-GAAP comparisons across the fiscal boundary mix two methods.

anomalies.name: Litigation developments with no accrual and a trial pending
anomalies.name_ko: 소송 진행 중, 충당부채 없음, 공판 예정
anomalies.what: The Arm complaint was amended, the motion to strike denied and trial is set after the filing date; the ParkerVision appeal was heard; no accrual is recorded for either matter.

anomalies.name: Restructuring amount differs between release and note
anomalies.name_ko: 구조조정 금액이 8-K와 주석에서 다름
anomalies.what: The release's quarterly restructuring exclusion is higher than the amount tagged in the 10-Q and stated in the note; the difference is small and could be charges recorded outside other expenses, but the documents disagree as stated.

anomalies.name: Gains tagged realized but described as unrealized
anomalies.name_ko: 유가증권 이익이 태그는 실현, 주석은 미실현
anomalies.what: The 10-Q tags the quarter's gains on marketable securities under a realized-gain concept while the footnote says they primarily consist of net unrealized gains on marketable equity securities that remain under lock-up; the amount matches, the character does not, and the character is what matters for cash.

anomalies.name: Pricing actions in the release, absent from the MD&A
anomalies.name_ko: 가격 인상 조치가 8-K에만 있고 MD&A에는 없음
anomalies.what: The release says pricing actions will benefit gross margin over time; the MD&A's parallel paragraph on input costs says they could hurt margins and does not mention pricing; gross margin is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, the lowest of six quarters.

anomalies.name: Release headlines feature growth lines while total revenue falls
anomalies.name_ko: 8-K 헤드라인은 성장 부문만, 전체 매출은 감소
anomalies.what: The headlines cite automotive and IoT growth and omit handsets; the release's own table shows handsets down sharply and total revenue is down {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct}; the numbers support both the headline and the omission.

anomalies.name: High-end-of-guidance claim cannot be verified
anomalies.name_ko: 가이던스 상단 달성 주장 검증 불가
anomalies.what: The CEO says revenue came in at the high end of guidance; the prior quarter's range is not in the input, and the filed revenue is below both the year-ago and the prior quarter.

anomalies.name: Inventory days at a six-quarter high with reserves unobservable
anomalies.name_ko: 재고회전일수 여섯 분기 최고, 충당금 관측 불가
anomalies.what: Days sales of inventory are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} against {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} the prior quarter, {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} a year earlier and {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} for fiscal 2025; inventory is {terms.balances_now.inventory} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory}; gross margin is at its six-quarter low; no inventory reserve is tagged. Management cites customer demand impacts from memory supply constraints.

anomalies.name: Inventory build led by work in process and raw materials
anomalies.name_ko: 재고 증가를 재공품과 원재료가 주도
anomalies.what: Raw materials and work in process grew most among the components; a build caused by customers unable to take product would be expected to show in finished goods first, so the stated cause explains the build but not its mix, which looks like committed purchases and production continuing — consistent with the advance supply payments being consumed.

anomalies.name: Concentration rising in the largest customer
anomalies.name_ko: 최대 고객 비중 상승
anomalies.what: The largest customer is {concentration.facts.39.value|pct} of quarterly revenue against {concentration.facts.21.value|pct} a year earlier and {concentration.facts.40.value|pct} year to date against {concentration.facts.22.value|pct}; the second is {concentration.facts.41.value|pct} against {concentration.facts.23.value|pct}; China was {concentration.facts.27.value|pct} of fiscal 2025 revenue. No text discusses the shift.

anomalies.name: Third major customer no longer tagged
anomalies.name_ko: 세 번째 주요 고객이 더 이상 태깅되지 않음
anomalies.what: A third customer that was {concentration.facts.25.value|pct} of the year-ago quarter's revenue and {concentration.facts.26.value|pct} of the year-ago nine months has no fact for the current quarter or year to date; the legend that would explain the omission is marked unchanged and not visible.

anomalies.name: Channel signals: receivables and incentives up while revenue is down
anomalies.name_ko: 채널 신호: 매출 감소 속 매출채권·인센티브 증가
anomalies.what: Receivables rose ({terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_receivables} trailing) while revenue fell ({ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct}), accrued customer incentives rose with payment timing cited, and unearned revenue was drawn down; no disclosure of extended terms, returns or sell-through is in the input, so this is a signal to watch, not a finding of channel stuffing.

anomalies.name: Capacity commitments beside rising inventory and falling revenue
anomalies.name_ko: 매출 감소·재고 증가 속 생산능력 약정
anomalies.what: Multi-year capacity purchase commitments exist and their advance payments are being consumed while inventory reaches a six-quarter high in days and revenue falls; the commitment amount is not in the record, so excess-commitment exposure cannot be sized.

anomalies.name: Strategic investment gains a large share of pretax income
anomalies.name_ko: 전략투자 이익이 세전이익의 큰 비중
anomalies.what: QSI segment pretax income is a large part of the quarter's consolidated pretax income through IPO and remeasurement gains that the release excludes from non-GAAP; no item links an investee to a customer or a financed sale, so no circular-deal evidence is found.

anomalies.name: Gross margin at a low with input-cost pressure
anomalies.name_ko: 원가 압박 속 매출총이익률 최저
anomalies.what: Quarterly gross margin is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, the lowest of six quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.gross_margin|pct} a year earlier and {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} for fiscal 2025, itself the lowest of five years; the trailing figure is {ratios.profitability.gross_margin|pct}. The release attributes it to broad-based input-cost increases and promises pricing actions over time.

adjustments.name: Repayment of acquired company's debt treated as acquisition cash
adjustments.quote: Repayment of debt of an acquired company is 174000000.

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 최근 네 분기 기준 영업현금흐름 대비 순이익 비율은 {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}로 과거 범위 안에 있지만, 이번 분기 영업현금흐름은 {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}로 순이익 {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter}에 크게 못 미치고 전년 동기 대비 {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct} 줄었습니다. 재고 증가가 최근 네 분기 순이익의 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.share_of_net_income|pct}를 흡수했고, 분기 순이익에는 아직 팔 수 없는 상장 투자지분의 미실현 평가이익이 들어 있습니다.
summary_ko.revenue_recognition: 분기 매출이 {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} 줄었는데도 매출채권은 늘었고 이를 설명하는 주석이 없으며, 분기별 매출채권회전일수는 태깅 개념 차이로 계산되지 않습니다. 선수수익은 {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities}로 줄어들었고, 로열티 매출은 라이선시 판매 추정치에 기대고 있습니다.
summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 대손·재고·보증 충당금 비율은 기록에 태깅되지 않아 확인할 수 없습니다. 2025 회계연도에 쌓은 미국 연방 이연법인세 평가충당금을 2026 회계연도 둘째 분기에 환입해 연간 유효세율이 마이너스로 추정되며, 최근 네 분기 유효세율은 {tax_rate|pct}이고 Alphawave 영업권은 설명 없이 수정되었습니다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 개발비 자본화는 보이지 않고 연구개발비 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense}는 전액 비용 처리되지만 고객 상환금을 차감한 순액으로 표시됩니다. 소프트 자산 비중은 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct}로 여섯 분기 중 최고이며, 구조조정·인수 관련 비용 같은 일회성 항목이 매 분기 반복되고 비GAAP 격차는 계산기로 측정할 수 없습니다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 매출채권 매각이나 공급망금융은 기록에 태깅된 것이 없습니다. 다만 현금흐름표의 인수 지출이 계산기가 읽는 태그에 없어 품질조정 잉여현금흐름 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}는 인수 현금을 빼지 않았고, 주식으로 지불한 인수를 자사주 매입으로 상쇄하고 있으며, 최근 네 분기 자사주 매입 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases}는 이 잉여현금흐름을 넘어 현금 감소와 기업어음으로 메워졌습니다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 공시통제는 유효하다고 결론지었고 감사인 교체나 중요한 취약점은 입력에 없습니다. 다만 Alphawave 영업권이 설명 없이 수정되었고, 10-K와 10-Q 사이에 세그먼트 매출원가 부호와 매출채권 태깅 개념이 다르며, 8-K와 10-Q의 구조조정 금액이 일치하지 않습니다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 주석 항목 대부분은 숫자로 확인되지만, 구조조정 금액(8-K와 주석)과 유가증권 이익의 성격(태그는 실현, 주석은 미실현)은 서로 어긋납니다. 가격 인상 조치는 8-K에만 있고 MD&A에는 없으며, 이 두 가지를 빼면 8-K 실적 발표는 10-Q와 일치합니다.
summary_ko.industry_lens: 재고회전일수는 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}일로 여섯 분기 중 최고이고 원재료와 재공품이 가장 많이 늘었는데, 회사는 메모리 공급 제약에 따른 고객 수요 영향이라고 설명합니다. 최대 고객 비중은 {concentration.facts.39.value|pct}로 전년 동기 {concentration.facts.21.value|pct}에서 높아졌고, 매출 감소 속 매출채권과 고객 인센티브 증가는 채널 신호로 지켜볼 필요가 있으며 순환거래 징후는 발견되지 않았습니다.

limits: This analysis finds where the numbers and the explanations disagree, and where the company differs from its own past. It does not judge intent, and it cannot see evidence outside the filings, such as invoices or contracts.
